newsitem.title: USA: 1st Bancorp to close loan offices.
newsitem.headline: 1st Bancorp to close loan offices.

text.p: 1st Bancorp said Friday its First Federal Bank unit was closing three of its four loan production offices prior to June 30.
"As a result of this action, corporate net earnings are expected to increase to a level above that being experienced currently," the company said in a news release.
Overhead for the three offices currently exceeds $2 million annually, the company said.

"...with the influx of new players in the subpar financing market, and the subsequent loosening of underwriting standards by some of the companies competing for this business, remaining in the market is no longer a reasonable financial option for the bank," chairman C. James McCormick said in a news release.
